scope: Signal Shelter, a small 3D puzzle created in the extracted Windows creator with preinstalled Microsoft build tools. A separate installed Codex CLI connected to the open creator project through its live native MCP endpoint. The test supplied the brief, starter, approvals, a targeted compiler repair prompt and independent verification.

authoring.first_build_failure: Four C# CS1503 errors because position coordinates are double and the new helper took float.

retained_harness_failures: The UI Automation harness expected the ordinary export folder name. The verified export lived under the checkpoint. The creator report passed and the same bundle was copied and verified at a new path.
The first independent save-continuation driver requested compact module inspection and lacked the backend field. The corrected full-schema request completed the same play and save assertions.
